entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Getting developer exception page when didn't enable it #64140
  • model validation for classes with members that have the required keyword is handled differently in Controller API and Minimal API #64139
  • Feature Request: Cache-Control Header For Static Files #64138
  • VoidTaskResultGetter is never created or consumed as expected #64137
  • OpenApi Hybrid Type Options #64136
  • SystemTextJsonValidationMetadataProvider enfore use of JsonPropertyNameAttribute when FromHeaderAttribute in use #64135
  • [Blazor] InputBase does not update FieldIdentifier when bound model instance changes #64134

Closed

  • Overridden razor page lifecycle methods detected as page handlers #63692
  • [Blazor] LayoutAttribute.LayoutType should have proper trimming annotation #64119
    Backlog
  • Error in default Blazor app BALZOR106 #64073
  • Migration from .NET 8 to .NET 9 gives an error when publishing #64130
